Rotate into AI-infrastructure names (MRVL, ALAB, COHR) and data-storage (SNDK) for Q3 follow-through; trim IDX tech laggards to fund this.

Small-cap financials (HDFA, BEKS, IMJS) show high volatility and event-driven spikes, signaling speculative froth that institutional investors should avoid unless backed by clear earnings catalysts.

Accumulate ARTO on digital-payment structural tailwind. Trim BEKS/IMJS on weak fundamentals. Position for Q3 earnings: prefer banks with strong CASA and low NPL.

Favor names with recurring income and landbank monetization catalysts, as the sector's +1.81% local outperformance versus a -0.28% US decline confirms domestic risk-on appetite. Position for a 3-6 month window, trimming into any index-level pullback.
